description: Public scenario manifest for v1 to v2 migration conformance. Harnesses use these scenario ids and criteria when evaluating published Durable Workflow artifacts.

scenarios.title: Published artifact install only
operations: install the source v1 server, target v2 server, CLI, PHP workflow runtimes, Python SDK, and Waterline from published channels
record the resolved artifact name, version, and install source for every actor
run no product code from a local checkout
pass_criteria: the result document records every resolved artifact version
artifact_sources records one source for every required install channel
all actors under test came from published install channels
local product source checkouts are not used as artifacts under test

scenarios.title: Latest supported v1 state setup
operations: start from the documented latest supported v1 release set
inventory the selected v1 artifact capabilities before evaluating continuity
seed completed, running, waiting, retrying, and queued workflow state through public v1 surfaces
record source-absent schedules and worker-registration projections with their stable capability reason codes
capture preupgrade state snapshots without reading private storage internals
pass_criteria: the source release versions are resolved and recorded
every durable state kind supported by the source exists before the upgrade begins
source-absent control-plane state is classified as not applicable instead of lost
preupgrade observations are captured through supported CLI, SDK, or HTTP surfaces

scenarios.title: Documented migration steps execute
operations: follow the published v1 to v2 migration guide in order
record every command, configuration change, migration output, and process restart
start the v2 server against the migrated state
pass_criteria: every documented migration step exits successfully or reports an explicitly documented no-op
the v2 server reports healthy and ready after migration
the result links the migration guide revision used for the run

scenarios.title: Completed history preservation and replay
operations: export a completed v1 run history before migration
export the same run history after migration
replay or query the migrated completed run through every claimed v2 runtime surface
pass_criteria: postupgrade history preserves the ordered durable events and payloads needed for replay
v2 replay or query returns the same durable result observed before migration
the migrated completed run remains visible through CLI and HTTP history surfaces

scenarios.title: In-flight workflow progress is preserved
operations: pause a v1 workflow after a durable progress marker and before completion
migrate while the workflow is still open
resume workers on v2 and observe the run through CLI, HTTP, and Waterline surfaces
pass_criteria: the run resumes from the preupgrade progress marker instead of restarting
no completed step is repeated after migration
the workflow reaches the documented terminal result under v2 workers

scenarios.title: Mid-activity retry state is preserved
operations: seed a v1 activity that has failed at least once and is waiting for retry
migrate before the next retry fires
resume workers on v2 and record the next attempt and final activity result
pass_criteria: the retry attempt count and retry policy survive migration
v2 does not execute an extra duplicate attempt before the scheduled retry
the activity completes or fails according to the original durable retry policy

scenarios.title: Durable queue state is preserved
operations: capture a queued v1 workflow or activity task before migration
migrate without draining or replacing the durable task identity
observe the same task and its deterministic disposition after the v2 runtime starts
pass_criteria: the pending task identity, workflow or activity relationship, and durable pre-upgrade queue placement are observed
the task is not duplicated or silently dropped
the migrated task remains claimable or is completed, deliberately recovered, or explicitly refused with operator-visible evidence

scenarios.title: Schedule cadence survives upgrade
operations: create an active v1 schedule with a cadence short enough to observe before and after migration
migrate across at least one expected tick boundary
compare scheduled run creation times and operator-visible schedule state
pass_criteria: the schedule remains enabled with the same durable spec after migration
no scheduled tick is silently skipped or duplicated across the upgrade window
CLI and Waterline surfaces expose the migrated schedule state
when the selected v1 release has no schedule surface, the cell is not applicable with the published stable reason code

scenarios.title: Worker registration projection is preserved
operations: register v1 workers on at least two task queues before migration
migrate and register compatible v2 workers on the same task queues
capture worker-list, task-queue, and Waterline visibility after migration
pass_criteria: preupgrade worker registrations are projected into the documented v2 visibility model
new v2 workers can poll the migrated task queues without losing task-queue identity
operator surfaces distinguish stale preupgrade workers from live postupgrade workers
when the selected v1 release has no worker-registration projection, the preservation cell is not applicable with the published stable reason code

scenarios.title: Waterline operator visibility is preserved
operations: capture Waterline list, detail, run, and history views before migration
migrate and refresh the same views after migration
compare visible statuses, timestamps, task queues, schedule links, and history links
pass_criteria: Waterline continues to show preupgrade runs after migration
status, run identity, and history navigation remain stable for migrated runs
missing fields are recorded as focused visibility findings against the owning surface

scenarios.title: CLI can inspect preupgrade state after migration
operations: use the v2 CLI to describe migrated v1-origin workflows
export migrated histories and query run details in JSON mode
query the corresponding v2 operator APIs and record typed response envelopes
pass_criteria: the CLI can inspect migrated v1-origin workflow state without private storage access
CLI and operator API JSON envelopes remain typed for migrated objects
errors for unsupported migrated fields are typed and actionable

scenarios.title: New v2 workflow starts after upgrade
operations: start a new v2 workflow after migrated state is available
run it beside migrated v1-origin runs on the same server
capture completion, history, and operator visibility for both cohorts
pass_criteria: new v2 starts succeed after migration
new v2 run identity and history do not collide with migrated v1-origin runs
operator and CLI surfaces can distinguish new v2 starts from migrated runs when the product exposes that distinction

scenarios.title: New v2 schedule runs after upgrade
operations: create a net-new v2 schedule after migrated v1-origin workflow state is readable
inspect it through the v2 CLI and operator API
observe at least one scheduled tick
pass_criteria: v2 schedule creation succeeds regardless of source schedule capability
CLI and operator API responses are typed
the schedule produces the expected v2 run

scenarios.title: New v2 worker registration is visible after upgrade
operations: register a net-new v2 worker after migration through the public worker protocol on a unique task queue
inspect the worker through typed v2 operator API and CLI projections
capture worker identity, namespace, task queue, freshness and status, task slots, and protocol metadata
poll the unique task queue through the public worker protocol and retain the request, response, exit code, and timestamps
pass_criteria: v2 worker registration succeeds regardless of source projection capability
the operator API and CLI return matching typed worker and task-queue projections
the projections identify a fresh worker with task-slot and protocol metadata
the registered worker polls successfully with exact request-response and process evidence
transport or host failures are runner-blocked while HTTP, CLI, projection, or poll contract failures are routed to the owning public surface with the exact artifact tuple

scenarios.title: Rollback contract is verified
operations: follow the published rollback procedure from the migration guide
record which migrated state is documented as rollback-safe or rollback-refused
capture the exact public operator signal that classifies rollback as supported, refused, or irreversible
inspect postrollback workflow, schedule, CLI, and Waterline surfaces
pass_criteria: supported rollback state remains executable and inspectable after rollback
irreversible or unsupported rollback state is refused with a documented typed error
the result records the exact public operator-visible rollback signal
rollback does not silently mutate migrated state into an undocumented partial form

scenarios.title: Version skew refuses loudly
operations: inventory the endpoint capabilities required by every skew cell before sending a request
attempt documented unsupported v1 server with v2 worker and v2 server with v1 worker combinations only where both artifacts expose the endpoint
record inapplicable combinations as preflight refusals with stable source-capability reasons and no mutation attempt
capture refusal errors and operator-visible diagnostics
pass_criteria: unsupported version-skew combinations refuse before partially mutating durable state
skew cells with a nonexistent source endpoint are not executed and carry explicit not-applicable reasons
refusal errors name the incompatible component and expected version range
CLI and worker refusal cells include request and response evidence
CLI, SDK, or Waterline diagnostics expose enough context for an operator to correct the mismatch
